soundness_flags.label: ass:polynomial-lower-mass
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Gaiffas condition is pointwise one-dimensional radial regular variation of a design density, not the proposal's uniform two-sided boundary local-mass lower bound; moreover a lower bound alone is not regular variation.

soundness_flags.label: prop:observed-law-identification
soundness_flags.one_line: The unqualified limit of E_P[Y(t)|X=z] is version-dependent; state the equality only for the specified Lipschitz representative (or its continuous extension).

soundness_flags.label: oeq:honest-adaptive-bands
soundness_flags.one_line: “Expected local half-width matches the thickness--entropy estimation frontier at every boundary point” lacks a defined local risk/width benchmark, and the proposed separation condition has no quantified profile class.
